anchor.statement: Lemma 4.4. Fix h ∈ (0, 1/2). For i = 1, 2, let (U i , E i ) be smooth on (0, ∞ ) × [−1, 1], with E i > 0, and suppose the five integrals in (4.15) define smooth functions there, including one-sided η -derivatives at η = ±1. Write H i = √ 2XE i , m i = (M i , I i , J i , S i , C p,i ). Fix one smooth function Π ax ( η ) on [−1, 1] and set Π i (X, η ) = Π ax ( η ) + C p,i (X, η ), Π i (0, η ) = Π ax ( η ), i = 1, 2. Thus the pressures have the same integration constant at the axis; the velocity profiles need not agree near the axis. Define V 0,i by (4.7), Q s,i , N s,i by (4.16), and p s,i , a i , b s,i , T 0,i by (4.11). We use the explicit formulas (4.16), previously derived with C Q = C N = 0. For any of these quantities f , let ∆ f = f 2 − f 1 . Then the following two conclusions hold.

correspondence.note: Part (ii), the estimate (4.17), is stated by profile_comparison_norm for the literal five integrals M, I, J, S, C_p of profiles that need not be regular at the axis. Part (i) is not stated by any declaration: the reader must propagate each of the five integrals past X_h by interval additivity (integral_equal_after and history_equal_after do this for one density, on regular-at-axis ProfileHistories profiles, a different structure from the one in part (ii)), then deduce equal pressure (pressure_equal_after), equal Q_s, N_s (profiles_stocks_congr, stocks_formulas), and equal V_0, p_s, a_i, b_{s,i}, T_{0,i} from their formulas (4.7) and (4.11), which no cited declaration states; this combination is the reviewer's argument.

conclusion.text:
have p := NavierStokes.SeedHandbackJets.packet P₀ f;
have W := (X - 2 * NavierStokes.NaturalAxisData.D h * η * p 2 η - NavierStokes.NaturalAxisData.d η * p 3 η) / X;
NavierStokes.SeedHandbackJets.stocks h X P₀ f 0 η =
    -W +
      ((1 - h) * p 4 η - NavierStokes.NaturalAxisData.D h * η * p 5 η - NavierStokes.NaturalAxisData.d η * p 7 η +
          2 * (h - NavierStokes.NaturalAxisData.D h) * η * p 6 η) /
        (X * √(2 * X) * p 0 η) ∧
  NavierStokes.SeedHandbackJets.stocks h X P₀ f 1 η =
      -W * p 1 η +
            (NavierStokes.NaturalAxisData.D h * (p 2 η - η * p 3 η) + 4 * h * η * p 8 η -
                NavierStokes.NaturalAxisData.d η * p 9 η) /
              X +
          4 * NavierStokes.NaturalAxisData.A h * η * p 10 η -
        NavierStokes.NaturalAxisData.d η * p 11 η ∧
    NavierStokes.SeedHandbackJets.stocks h X P₀ f 2 η =
        X / NavierStokes.NaturalAxisData.L h η * NavierStokes.SeedHandbackJets.stocks h X P₀ f 0 η ∧
      NavierStokes.SeedHandbackJets.stocks h X P₀ f 3 η =
        X / (NavierStokes.NaturalAxisData.L h η * p 0 η) * NavierStokes.SeedHandbackJets.stocks h X P₀ f 1 η
